lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhè shì nǐ de gǒu ma? Zhēn kě'ài!
lines.english: Is this your dog? So cute!

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，它叫小白。今年三岁了。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, tā jiào Xiǎobái. Jīnnián sān suì le.
lines.english: Yes, its name is Xiaobai. It's three years old this year.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Tā chī gǒuliáng, yě xǐhuan chī ròu.
lines.english: It eats dog food, and also likes to eat meat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.hanzi: 你每天带它出去跑步吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ měitiān dài tā chūqù pǎobù ma?
lines.english: Do you take it out for a run every day?

lines.speaker: B
lines.hanzi: 是的，早上和晚上各一次。它很喜欢跑。
lines.pinyin: Shì de, zǎoshang hé wǎnshang gè yí cì. Tā hěn xǐhuan pǎo.
lines.english: Yes, once in the morning and once in the evening. It likes running a lot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě xiǎng yǎng yī zhī gǒu.
lines.english: I also want to have a dog.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Yǎng gǒu hěn lèi, dàn yě hěn kāixīn.
lines.english: Having a dog is tiring, but also very happy.
